title: ALT-W: long-press copy-search from external apps does not work reliably
description: User report: pressing alt+w long-press over a selection in an external app does not populate the search. Investigate lib.rs long-press path (sentinel, 120ms sleep, enigo Ctrl+C timing, focus). Likely interacts with M2/M3/H2.
notes:
Reopened: modifier-release approach lets hardware W auto-repeat through as plain 'w' once Alt is logically up. New approach: long-press is recognized at 350ms but the copy fires on key RELEASE.
Release-trigger UX rejected by user; reimplementing hold-to-fire with a WH_KEYBOARD_LL suppression hook (AHK v1 parity).
close_reason: Verified working in Chrome and Win11 Notepad. Final chain: real VK_C copy + Ctrl-before-Alt-up + vkFF menu mask + RegisterHotKey repeat guards released on physical key-up.

title: C1: save_settings persists bad db_path before validation; app panics on next launch
description: commands.rs:587 writes settings.json before db::open validates the new path (commands.rs:596). A bad db_path is persisted; next launch lib.rs:225 db::open fails inside .setup() and .expect() panics. Fix: validate before persisting + fallback to default path at startup.
close_reason: Fixed in bugfix/bug-hunt-fixes: modifier release + clipboard poll + image backup + in-flight guard + debounce worker + db_path validation/fallback. Manual verification of alt+w long-press still pending.

title: H5: recorded pron and browser TTS do not cancel each other; out-of-order playPron

close_reason: Frontend wiring complete; tsc + vite build + 119 vitest green

title: H4: runLookup has no request-identity guard; stale responses overwrite newer results

title: H1: upsert_entry wipes media1 US pronunciation on every re-cache; media_tried makes loss permanent
description: db.rs:181 UPDATE sets media1=?2 unconditionally and all production callers pass None (commands.rs:294,416). UK media2 survives. After wipe, set_media_tried=1 prevents any future retry. Fix: remove media1 param from upsert_entry; pron columns owned by update_pron only.

title: 영어 뜻풀이에서 표제어 하이라이트 시 앞뒤 한 단어까지 밑줄 표시
description:
영어 단어 조회 시 뜻풀이(설명문) 안에서 해당 표제어를 붉게 표시하는 기능이 있는데, 표제어 자체뿐 아니라 바로 앞 한 단어와 바로 뒤 한 단어까지 밑줄을 그어 함께 강조한다. 목적은 단어의 실제 용법(콜로케이션/문맥)을 자연스럽게 익히도록 돕는 것.

- 대상: 영어 단어 뜻풀이 렌더링(설명문)
- 붉은 표시: 기존 표제어 강조 유지
- 추가: 표제어 앞 1단어 + 뒤 1단어에 밑줄
- 경계 처리: 문장 시작/끝, 구두점 인접 시 처리 필요

title: M9: side effects inside setState functional updaters (double-fire under StrictMode)
description: useSettings.ts:49-55, useHistory.ts:33-51, useFavorites.ts:38-44 call saveSettings/persist inside updater. React requires pure updaters; StrictMode invokes twice. Fix: compute next outside, setState(next), then persist.
close_reason: Frontend wiring complete; tsc + vite build + 119 vitest green

title: M8: blocking SQLite/file IO inside tokio tasks without spawn_blocking
description: commands.rs:456-504 db::open (schema DDL each call) + rusqlite calls run directly in async tasks; up to READING_MAX=5 concurrently can stall the runtime. Fix: wrap DB work in tokio::task::spawn_blocking.
close_reason: Fixed in background-task redesign commit; verified by cargo test + clippy

title: M7: in-flight background pron download writes to abandoned DB after db_path change

close_reason: Fixed in background-task redesign commit; verified by cargo test + clippy

title: M6: mutex poison handled with unwrap_or_default -> empty PathBuf opens stray DB file
